title: Leome and Partners footer
description: A footer framed by a backdrop photo: an inset flat panel with a large mark, a column of 24px links and an opening-hours note with a small square, the firm's name set across the full width whose letters rise one after another as it scrolls in, and a row of small uppercase legal links. Links roll letter by letter on hover.
notes: the wordmark is 11vw (10.2vw on phones): about 14–16 characters fill the width
the frame shows the media; empty, it is a soft glow gradient
the letter rise is CSS scroll-driven; off under prefers-reduced-motion
